'''2016 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This…]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open You Can Either Profit By This Baron.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130753/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]
